Push mode is unchanged (`submitted` is always `None` there → gate reduces to `is_done`). - `prompt.py` — `build_finishing` is now mode-aware (`stack=` param): stack mode tells the agent to **leave In Progress** (PR is the completion signal); push mode still marks Done. - `stop_guard.py` — the stack block-prompt no longer says "transition to Done." **Defect #2 — watch-pane blackout** The finishing sub-agent runs off the tmux split-pane, and its `run_issue` calls passed no `on_progress` and emitted no completion line — so both panes went silent for the whole run, reading as a hang. Both spawn sites now pass `on_progress` (per-turn heartbeat in the orchestrator pane, which sits beside the worker split) and emit a `finishing sub-agent done: N turns, $X` line via the new `_log_finishing_done` helper. - I did **not** give the finishing agent its own split-pane (that's a heavier tmux-lifecycle change).
